name: Jarvis
changes_cs: Chatova plocha, svisly splitter a panel Soubory projektu / GitHub / Nahled jsou ted deti jednoho nadrazeneho pracovniho panelu, takze se roztahuji a chovaji jako jeden celek.
changes_en: The chat surface, vertical splitter, and Project files / GitHub / Preview panel are now children of one parent work panel, so they resize and behave as one unit.

history.changes_cs: Chatova plocha, svisly splitter a panel Soubory projektu / GitHub / Nahled jsou ted deti jednoho nadrazeneho pracovniho panelu, takze se roztahuji a chovaji jako jeden celek.
history.changes_en: The chat surface, vertical splitter, and Project files / GitHub / Preview panel are now children of one parent work panel, so they resize and behave as one unit.

history.changes_cs: Levy panel nahrazuje samostatne sekce Projekty a Chaty jednim hierarchickym listboxem; projekty jsou vetve a chaty odsazene polozky pod nimi. Pravy klik nad polozkou otevre odpovidajici projektove nebo chatove akce.
history.changes_en: The left panel replaces separate Projects and Chats sections with one hierarchical list box; projects are branches and chats are indented child rows. Right-clicking an item opens the matching project or chat actions.

history.changes_cs: Levy panel nahrazuje samostatne sekce Projekty a Chaty jednim hierarchickym listboxem; projekty jsou vetve a chaty odsazene polozky pod nimi. Pravy klik nad polozkou otevre odpovidajici projektove nebo chatove akce.
history.changes_en: The left panel replaces separate Projects and Chats sections with one hierarchical list box; projects are branches and chats are indented child rows. Right-clicking an item opens the matching project or chat actions.

history.changes_cs: Sjednocuje spodni chatovy composer do jednoho panelu pod celou pracovni oblasti. Progress, vstup, akce a fronta se roztahuji pod chatem i pravym panelem Soubory projektu / GitHub a pravy panel se zkracuje nad composer.
history.changes_en: Unifies the bottom chat composer into one panel below the whole work area. Progress, input, actions, and queue now stretch below both the chat and the Project files / GitHub panel, and the right panel stops above the composer.

history.changes_cs: Presouva prepinac panelu Soubory projektu / GitHub do praveho konce menu radku a omezuje svisly splitter i pravy panel na oblast chatu, aby nezasahovaly do celeho okna.
history.changes_en: Moves the Project files / GitHub panel toggle to the right end of the menu row and scopes the vertical splitter and right panel to the chat area instead of the whole window.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis po instalaci, aktualizaci i obnoveni z tray znovu synchronizuje rozlozeni okna a rucni runtime panely, takze UI zustane roztazene bez nutnosti kliknout na vychozi velikost.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now resynchronizes window layout and runtime panels after install, update, and tray restore, so the UI stays stretched without needing the default-size button.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis po instalaci a aktualizaci dorovnava rozlozeni okna stejne jako pri rucnim nastaveni vychozi velikosti, takze panely a scrollbar nezustanou na stare geometrii.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now resynchronizes the window layout after install/update startup the same way as the manual default-size action, so panels and scrollbars no longer keep stale geometry.

history.changes_cs: JarvisSetup.exe ted pouziva stejny cisty vychozi vzhled Windows 11 Auto jako Jarvis. Setup si nese sdileny WDUi skin katalog v resourcech, takze ani samostatne stazeny setup neskonci ve starem Task Board stylu.
history.changes_en: JarvisSetup.exe now uses the same clean Windows 11 Auto default look as Jarvis. The setup carries the shared WDUi skin catalog as an embedded resource, so even a standalone downloaded setup no longer falls back to the old Task Board style.

history.changes_cs: Opravuje dve obnovovaci chyby UI: chaty pod projekty si po obnoveni okna z minimalizace hned zachovaji odsazeni a tray popup po pravem kliku zustane otevreny i kdyz je hlavni okno schovane.
history.changes_en: Fixes two restore UI issues: project chats keep their indentation immediately after restoring from minimize, and the tray popup stays open on right-click while the main window is hidden.

history.changes_cs: Odpovedi Jarvise v chatu se vykresluji jako Markdown: nadpisy, odrazky, cislovane seznamy, citace, oddelovace a kodove bloky maji citelne formatovani primo v konverzaci.
history.changes_en: Jarvis chat replies now render as Markdown: headings, bullets, numbered lists, quotes, separators, and code blocks are formatted directly in the conversation.

history.changes_cs: Opravuje pravy panel Soubory projektu: po otevreni nahledu souboru zustava seznam projektu naplneny a jeho scroll se pri zmene vysky sekci udrzi v platnem rozsahu. Listboxy v panelu maji navic maly odstup, aby se ve skinech neurezaval horni ramecek.
history.changes_en: Fixes the Project files side panel: opening a file preview keeps the project file list populated and clamps its scroll after section height changes. The side-panel list boxes also keep a small inset so skinned top borders are not clipped.

history.changes_cs: Opravuje reset vychozi velikosti okna: sbalene a docasne neaktivni vetve UI ted pouzivaji WDUi collapsed stav a runtime layout uz neprepisuje referencni designove rozmery.
history.changes_en: Fixes default window-size reset: collapsed and temporarily inactive UI branches now use the WDUi collapsed state, and runtime layout no longer rewrites the reference design bounds.

history.changes_cs: Reset vychozi velikosti okna je ted stabilni: WDUi centruje defaultni velikost do pracovni oblasti monitoru a diagnosticky trace ukazuje reset target/work-area data. Jarvis prijima --diagnostic-trace pro resize/reset diagnostiku.
history.changes_en: Default window reset is now stable: WDUi centers the default size in the monitor work area and diagnostic trace now reports reset target/work-area data. Jarvis accepts --diagnostic-trace for resize/reset diagnostics.

history.changes_cs: Opravuje reset vychozi velikosti okna ve WDUi: reset uz nebere aktualni automaticke minimum obsahu, takze se okno vrati na default v jednom kroku misto postupneho zmensovani.
history.changes_en: Fixes WDUi default window reset: reset no longer uses the current automatic content minimum, so the window returns to the default in one step instead of shrinking incrementally.

history.changes_cs: Opravuje reset vychozi velikosti okna: Jarvis stavi WDUi layout na defaultni velikosti a ulozenou pozici aplikuje az potom, takze reset nesmrstava okno po malych krocich.
history.changes_en: Fixes default window size reset: Jarvis builds the WDUi layout at the default size and applies saved placement afterward, so reset no longer shrinks the window in tiny steps.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis byl znovu sestaven a publikovan s aktualnimi CPM metadata, setupem a checksumem.
history.changes_en: Jarvis was rebuilt and published with current CPM metadata, setup, and checksum.

history.changes_cs: Meni vychozi velikost okna Jarvise na 1000 x 800 px, zatimco minimalni zmensitelna velikost zustava 800 x 600 px.
history.changes_en: Changes Jarvis default window size to 1000 x 800 px while keeping the minimum resizable size at 800 x 600 px.

history.changes_cs: Pridava graficky nahled ikonovych souboru v internim prohlizeci projektu Jarvise.
history.changes_en: Adds graphical preview for icon files in Jarvis' internal project file viewer.

history.changes_cs: Migruje Jarvisovy tooltipy na aktualni WDUi pointer-intent pravidla: odstranuje stare texty, ktere z tooltipu delaly trvale menu, a dokumentuje ze delsi interakce patri do popupu nebo dialogu.
history.changes_en: Migrates Jarvis tooltips to the current WDUi pointer-intent rules: removes old text that treated tooltips as persistent menus, and documents that longer interactions belong in popups or dialogs.

history.changes_cs: Pridava tlacitko pro obnoveni vychozi velikosti okna, nastavuje vychozi velikost Jarvise na 800 x 600 px a preklada spodni chatove ovladani podle aktualni velikosti okna.
history.changes_en: Adds a title-bar button for restoring the default window size, changes Jarvis default size to 800 x 600 px, and lays out the bottom chat controls from the current window size.

history.changes_cs: Opravuje citelnost seznamu Soubory projektu / GitHub: radky v pravem panelu maji bezpecnou vysku textu a rozumny padding, takze se nazvy slozek a souboru neorezavaji ve skinech.
history.changes_en: Fixes readability in the Project files / GitHub list: right-panel rows now keep a safe text height and reasonable padding so folder and file names are not clipped by skins.

history.changes_cs: Doplnuje WDUi editacni pole o undo/redo, standardni klavesove zkratky a pohodlnejsi slovni navigaci a mazani, aby psani v Jarvisovi pusobilo jako v plnohodnotne desktopove aplikaci.
history.changes_en: Adds undo/redo, standard keyboard shortcuts, and more comfortable word navigation/deletion to WDUi edit fields so typing in Jarvis behaves like a full desktop application.

history.changes_cs: Nastavuje vychozi velikost hlavniho okna Jarvise po ciste instalaci na 1280 x 720, pripojuje ji k WDUi resetu velikosti a migruje starsi ulozenou geometrii na novy layout.
history.changes_en: Sets the clean-install default Jarvis main window size to 1280 x 720, wires it to WDUi size reset, and migrates older saved geometry to the new layout.

history.changes_cs: Zvetšuje spodni progressbar pod chatem na dvojnasobnou vysku a drzi odstup od vstupniho pole, aby byl citelnejsi.
history.changes_en: Doubles the bottom chat progress bar height and keeps spacing from the prompt field so progress is easier to read.

history.changes_cs: Opravuje rozlozeni Jarvisova horniho zahlavi a menu pri otevrenem repo panelu, zlepsuje citelnost seznamu Soubory projektu / GitHub a cisti ceske texty v repo vieweru.
history.changes_en: Fixes Jarvis title/menu layout with the repo panel open, improves Project files / GitHub list readability, and cleans up Czech text in the repo viewer.

history.changes_cs: Ikona pro postranni repo panel Soubory projektu / GitHub / Nahled je presunuta do praveho horniho rohu chatoveho prostoru, aby nebyla dole u vstupu.
history.changes_en: Moves the Project files / GitHub / File preview side-panel toggle to the upper-right corner of the chat area so it no longer sits near the prompt controls.

history.changes_cs: Pravy repo panel Jarvise ma svisly WDUi splitter mezi chatem a panelem Soubory projektu / GitHub / Nahled, takze lze menit jeho sirku bez opusteni chatu.
history.changes_en: Adds a vertical WDUi splitter between the chat and the Project files / GitHub / File preview side panel, so the repo panel width can be resized without leaving the chat.

history.changes_cs: Pravy panel Soubory projektu / GitHub / Nahled ma citelnejsi scrollovani: otevrene sekce maji vetsi minimalni vysku, listy maji zretelnejsi WDUi scrollbar a zachovavaji kolecko mysi.
history.changes_en: Improves scrolling in the Project files / GitHub / File preview side panel: open sections keep a larger minimum height, lists use a clearer WDUi scrollbar, and mouse-wheel scrolling stays available.

history.changes_cs: Nahled souboru v Jarvisovi uz neni syrovy textovy vypis. Projektovy a GitHub viewer formatuji Markdown, zvyraznuji kod, umi podporovane lokalni obrazky a dokumenty/media/binarni soubory zobrazuji jako ciste typove karty.
history.changes_en: Jarvis file preview is no longer a raw text dump. The project and GitHub viewers format Markdown, syntax-highlight code, render supported local images, and show document/media/binary files as clean type-aware cards.

history.changes_cs: Pravy panel Soubory projektu / GitHub ma dynamicke vysky sekci. Ve vychozim stavu je roztazeny jen seznam souboru projektu, GitHub a nahled jsou sbalene; pokud je otevreno vice sekci, mezi nimi jsou horizontalni splittery pro zmenu vysky.
history.changes_en: The Project files / GitHub side panel now has dynamic section heights. By default only the project file list is expanded, while GitHub and preview are collapsed; when multiple sections are open, horizontal splitters let their heights be resized.

history.changes_cs: Nahrazuje textovy prepinac Soubory projektu / GitHub malou 32barevnou WDUi tint bitmap ikonou primo v rohu chatu. Ikona ma samostatny stav pro otevreni a zrolovani panelu, lokalizovane tooltipy a prebarvuje se podle aktivniho skinu.
history.changes_en: Replaces the text Project files / GitHub toggle with a compact 32-color WDUi tint bitmap icon directly in the chat corner. The icon has separate open and collapse states, localized tooltips, and recolors with the active skin.

history.changes_cs: Pridava vykonovy rezim UI v nastaveni. Vychozi Auto drzi Jarvise svizne a pri praci nebo priprave lokalniho modelu docasne prepne WDUi na maximalni vykon, po dokonceni se vrati k ulozene volbe.
history.changes_en: Adds a UI performance mode setting. The default Auto mode keeps Jarvis responsive and temporarily switches WDUi to maximum performance while a local model is working or being prepared, then returns to the saved choice.

history.changes_cs: Dialog stahovani modelu lze pretahnout za horni kartu a minimalizovat do Windows; stahovani pokracuje dal a stale jde schovat do stavove ikonky Jarvise.
history.changes_en: The model download dialog can now be dragged by its header card and minimized to Windows; the download continues and can still be hidden to the Jarvis status icon.

history.changes_cs: Modelovy vyber ma v tooltipu vybraneho modelu akci Stahnout / pripravit, ktera spusti stejny nemodalni download dialog jako knihovna modelu. Jarvis je sestaven proti aktualni WDUi knihovne.
history.changes_en: The model picker now offers a Download / prepare action in the selected model tooltip, using the same modeless download dialog as the model library. Jarvis is built against the current WDUi library.

history.changes_cs: Modelovy dialog dostal hvezdickove ikonky u kazdeho vyberu modelu; kliknutim vrati profil na nejlepsi hardwarove vybranou volbu jako pri ciste instalaci.
history.changes_en: The model dialog now has star buttons beside each model selector; clicking one restores that profile to the best hardware-aware clean-install choice.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis ma sbalitelny postranni panel Soubory projektu / GitHub mimo chat. Panel je ve vychozim stavu sbaleny, funguje i mimo maximalizovane okno, nenacita GitHub dokud ho uzivatel nerozbali, listboxy umi prochazet lokalni projekt i GitHub repo a nahled souboru se otevre az po poklepani nebo Enteru.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now has a collapsible Project files / GitHub side panel outside the chat transcript. The panel is collapsed by default, works outside maximized windows, does not load GitHub until opened, list boxes can browse the local project and GitHub repo, and file preview opens only after double-click or Enter.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis ma sbalitelny postranni panel Soubory / GitHub mimo chat. Panel je ve vychozim stavu sbaleny, funguje i mimo maximalizovane okno, listboxy umi prochazet lokalni projekt a GitHub repo a nahled souboru se otevira az po poklepani nebo Enteru.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now has a collapsible Files / GitHub side panel outside the chat transcript. The panel is collapsed by default, works outside maximized windows, list boxes can browse the local project and GitHub repo, and file preview opens only after double-click or Enter.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis ted drzi vychozi jazyk odpovedi podle nastavene lokalizace a neprepina se jen proto, ze dotaz nebo zdrojovy text obsahuje jiny jazyk.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now keeps the default response language tied to the selected localization and no longer switches languages merely because the prompt or source text contains another language.

history.changes_cs: Cista instalace Jarvise ted voli modelove profily podle zjisteneho hardware a doplnuje lehke coding/reasoning fallbacky pro slabsi pocitace.
history.changes_en: Clean Jarvis installs now choose model profiles from detected hardware and add lightweight coding/reasoning fallbacks for weaker PCs.

history.changes_cs: Cista instalace Jarvise ted voli vychozi, rychly, programovaci, premysleci a vision model podle zjistene RAM/CPU/GPU misto jednoho pevneho profilu pro vsechny pocitace.
history.changes_en: Clean Jarvis installs now choose default, fast, coding, reasoning, and vision model profiles from detected RAM/CPU/GPU instead of using one fixed profile for every PC.
